cohort: 255 patients who underwent a surgical procedure in Wachemo University Nigist Eleni Mohamed Memorial Hospital (WUNEMMH).
finding: The rate of surgical site infection (SSI) was 16.5%, with Klebsiella pneumoniae identified as the most common causative agent, and factors such as surgery waiting time greater than 7 days, operation time greater than 1 hour, antibiotic administration before 1 hour of operation, and smoking were independently associated with SSIs.
